assets.license: Provenance unclear — NOT cleared for release. Taken from iErcann/enari-engine (the repository is MIT, but this model is not among the Sketchfab attributions in its README, and its material names "t_phoenix" and "v_hands" are Counter-Strike / Half-Life viewmodel conventions, so it is most likely derived from those assets). Included at the project owner's explicit request for a non-commercial test build. Replace before shipping.
assets.use: First-person rifle viewmodel: 14,091 triangles, rigged arms with gloved hands and a full finger chain, and an authored hold animation. Used for the AKM slot, and its hands rig is reused to hold the procedurally built weapons.
